meaning: The narrow scope premise STMT-MANDATE-COVERS-JESUS-FOUNDING-OF-CATHOLIC-CHURCH (if Jesus holds a mandate from g and founded the Catholic Church as a visible society with authority, he founded it in that mandate and commissioned it to teach) is derived from two premises: the report-to-event premise STMT-COMMISSION-REPORTS-GO-BACK-TO-JESUS (Matthew 28.18-20 and at least one of the four governing commissions, Matthew 16.18-19, 18.17-18, John 20.21-23, 21.15-17, go back to Jesus; Dei Verbum §19), and STMT-CHURCH-FOUNDED-IN-COMMISSIONED-APOSTLES (if Jesus holds a mandate from g and founded the Catholic Church, his giving a governing power makes the founding one in the mandate and his giving the power to teach is a commission of that Church to teach; Lumen gentium §§19, 22). The step depends on the reported content: it goes through because the reports name a governing power and the power to teach, and in a preaching-only model (Commissions.preachingOnly_fails_reports) premise 2 holds and premise 1 fails. Premise 2 is strictly weaker than the conclusion (Commissions.narrow_implies_link with the first omission model), but it carries the institutional content: the conclusion's two parts are its consequents, so the proof is a single application of it (recorded as a transcription). The 'institution or message' fork is split between the two premises, not moved onto premise 1. Each premise is necessary (Commissions.omissionModels); both are jointly satisfiable with stage 6 and every stage antecedent of the founding bridge (Commissions.jointModel). The message rival STMT-JESUS-MANDATE-COVERS-ONLY-MESSAGE may deny premise 2 (the second omission model satisfies the rival); granting premise 2, Jesus' mandate and his founding of the Catholic Church as a visible society with authority, must deny each of the four governing commissions (Commissions.messageRival_denies_governing_reports) but may keep Matthew 28 (Commissions.messageRival_compatible_with_mt28). Both premises are open.

strong_version_needed.STMT-CHURCH-FOUNDED-IN-COMMISSIONED-APOS: The conclusion includes a Catholic teaching commission. The governing-event-only institutional projection supplies founding-in-mandate but no teaching commission. GOVERNING-COMPONENT-TEACHING-OMISSION-CONTROLS retains full historical reports and a nonempty mandate/body while the weak link holds and narrow scope fails.
strong_version_needed.STMT-COMMISSION-REPORTS-GO-BACK-TO-JESUS: The old narrow-scope proof needs both a governing grant and the teaching grant from Matthew28. A mere governing witness omits teaching. GOVERNING-COMPONENT-TEACHING-OMISSION-CONTROLS retains the full institutional bridge and a nonempty mandate/body but only a governing grant, allowing teaching scope to fail. The historical bundle is an interface sufficient for both grants, not a claim that every listed report is needed.
